title: Cheap, didn't put a smooth edge on my chef knife
text:
Cheap, didn't put a smooth edge on my chef knife. Well, I am not the chef in the family. My husband is very particular about his knives, and has his own chosen sharpeners.

So, I decided to try a couple of non-professional chef knives in this sharpener.

First off, it comes with no directions. 1, 2 and 3 are on the box, but it doesn't say if one knife should go through all three slots, or if there are different slots for different knives. I just jumped on in with one of my chef knives that needed a refreshed edge.

I used slots 1 and 2. Again, not a professional chef, but the edges looked way too chewed up for my taste. This was easy to hold and easy to pull through a few times, but I wasn't happy with the edge it put on my knife.

So, I'm going to pass on this one. If you can afford a better sharpener, I'd advise you to do so.
